infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Doondo uses your location to find work near you.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Doondo uses your location to share live location with safety contacts when you choose to.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Doondo uses your camera for intro videos and verification.

infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Doondo uses speech recognition so you can search for jobs by voice.
